title: TITAN: DRL-Based Dynamic Scheduling and Resource Allocation for Tactile Internet
abstract: arXiv:2611.27560v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tactile Internet (TI) applications require ultra-reliable, low-latency tactile communication alongside video traffic. However, tactile Quality of Service (QoS) requirements vary with the interaction context, making fixed resource allocation inefficient. In this paper, we propose TITAN (Two-Timescale Integrated Tactile Internet over 5G Access Networks), a dynamic scheduling and resource allocation (SRA) scheme. TITAN receives time-varying tactile QoS profiles from a higher-layer module and adapts SRA to the current QoS profile and network state. A deep reinforcement learning-based agent splits the available network bandwidth between tactile and video streams at a slow timescale, while a fast-timescale scheduler allocates resource blocks among active user equipment. Through simulations, we show that TITAN simultaneously satisfies both tactile and video QoS targets and achieves a performance gain of 7.64 percentage points (pp) in the join

translated_title: TITAN：面向触觉互联网的基于深度强化学习的动态调度与资源分配
translated_abstract: 触觉互联网（TI）应用需要超可靠、低延迟的触觉通信与视频流量并行传输。然而，触觉服务质量（QoS）需求会随交互情境而变化，这使得固定的资源分配方式效率低下。本文提出了TITAN（5G接入网络上的双时间尺度集成触觉互联网），这是一种动态调度与资源分配（SRA）方案。TITAN从上层模块接收时变的触觉QoS配置，并根据当前的QoS配置和网络状态自适应地调整调度与资源分配。基于深度强化学习的智能体在慢时间尺度上对触觉流和视频流进行网络带宽划分，同时快时间尺度调度器则在活跃用户设备之间分配资源块。仿真结果表明，TITAN能够同时满足触觉和视频的QoS目标，并在联合……方面实现了7.64个百分点的性能提升。（注：原文摘要末尾被截断）
tldr: TITAN是一种基于深度强化学习的双时间尺度动态调度与资源分配方案，可根据时变的触觉QoS需求自适应地在触觉流与视频流之间划分带宽并分配资源块，同时满足两类业务的QoS目标并带来7.64个百分点的性能提升。
en_tdlr: TITAN is a DRL-based two-timescale dynamic scheduling and resource allocation scheme that adaptively splits bandwidth between tactile and video streams based on time-varying tactile QoS profiles, simultaneously satisfying both QoS targets with a 7.64 percentage point performance gain.
